products.title: Electric Toothbrush
products.description: This Aneebart sonic electric toothbrush set for adults includes two toothbrushes with different shapes and 12 precision replacement soft brush heads. It features a powerful motor vibrating up to 38,000 times per minute for deep cleaning and plaque removal. The device offers multiple brushing modes—including clean, white, polish, soft, massage, and care—to meet various oral health needs. It is IPX7 waterproof and features a USB rechargeable battery that can last over 30 days on a single charge.

products.name: Philips Sonicare 1100 Power Toothbrush
products.title: Philips Sonicare 1100 Power Toothbrush Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush
products.description: The Philips Sonicare 1100 is a rechargeable electric toothbrush designed for those transitioning from manual brushing. It features a slim ergonomic handle and a familiar-shaped brush head, utilizing Sonicare technology to pulse water between teeth for a thorough clean. The device includes a 2-minute SmarTimer with QuadPacer to ensure dentist-recommended brushing time and an easy-start feature that gradually increases power. A single charge lasts up to 2 weeks and includes a battery light indicator.
